The PMOS CS stage, matched to the mirror load, gives rail-ish swing; the inverter gives rails. Assumed IREF=10 uA (not given): tail 6 uA, CS 3 uA. Total ~19 uA, ~34 uW. Exceeds 39 uW if IREF > ~11.6 uA."}

PARAMS = {
    "Wref":  (10.0, 4.0, 20.0),   # NMOS diode for IREF, L=Lb
    "Wtail": (6.0, 2.0, 12.0),    # tail mirror width -> Itail = IREF*Wtail/Wref
    "Wsink": (3.0, 1.0, 8.0),     # stage-2 sink -> I2 = IREF*Wsink/Wref
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Win":   (4.0, 1.0, 12.0),    # input pair width
    "Lin":   (0.15, 0.15, 0.5),
    "Wld":   (2.0, 0.8, 6.0),     # PMOS mirror load width
    "Lld":   (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),
    "Winvn": (1.0, 0.42, 4.0),
    "Winvp": (3.0, 1.0, 10.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)   # assumed: IREF is not given in the spec
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    Lb, Lin, Lld = p["Lb"], p["Lin"], p["Lld"]

    itail = iref * p["Wtail"] / p["Wref"]
    i2 = iref * p["Wsink"] / p["Wref"]
    # CS PMOS current = (Wcs/Wld)*(itail/2); choose Wcs so this equals i2 (zero systematic offset)
    Wcs = p["Wld"] * i2 / (itail / 2)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.M("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wref"], Lb)
    n.M("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wtail"], Lb)
    # preamp: vinp up -> d1 current up -> mirror raises o1
    n.M("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], Lin)
    n.M("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", "nfet", p["Win"], Lin)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wld"], Lld)
    n.M("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wld"], Lld)
    # stage 2: o1 up -> PMOS CS off -> o2 low -> vout high
    n.M("M5", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wcs, Lld)
    n.M("M6", "o2", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wsink"], Lb)
    # output inverter
    n.M("M7", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Winvn"], 0.15)
    n.M("M8", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Winvp"], 0.15)

    # ---- first-order predictions ----
    vcm = 0.9
    vs = 0.3
    op1 = lut.op("n", p["Win"], Lin, vcm - vs, 0.45, vsb=vs)
    for _ in range(20):  # solve tail node so that M1 carries itail/2
        op1 = lut.op("n", p["Win"], Lin, vcm - vs, 0.45, vsb=vs)
        vs += 0.02 * math.log(max(op1["Id"], 1e-12) / (itail / 2))
        vs = min(max(vs, 0.05), 0.6)
    gm1 = op1["gm"] * itail / 2 / max(op1["Id"], 1e-12)
    opl = lut.op("p", p["Wld"], Lld, 1.05, 0.9)
    gdsl = opl["gds"] * itail / 2 / max(opl["Id"], 1e-12)
    gdsn = op1["gds"] * itail / 2 / max(op1["Id"], 1e-12)
    a1 = gm1 / (gdsn + gdsl)
    c1 = (opl["cgg"] * Wcs / p["Wld"]) + 2e-15 * (p["Win"] + p["Wld"]) / 3 + 3e-15
    tau1 = c1 * a1 / gm1
    t1 = math.log(2) * tau1
    # stage 2 slewing on ~0.1 V drive of o1
    gm2 = opl["gm"] * Wcs / p["Wld"] * i2 / max(opl["Id"] * Wcs / p["Wld"], 1e-12)
    c2 = 1e-15 * (p["Winvn"] + p["Winvp"]) * 1.5 + 3e-15
    idrv = min(gm2 * min(a1 * vod, 0.2), 3 * i2) + 1e-9
    t2 = c2 * 0.9 / idrv
    # inverter driving CL
    opn = lut.op("n", p["Winvn"], 0.15, 1.2, 0.9)
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / max(opn["Id"], 1e-9)
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3

    power = vdd * (iref + itail + i2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1, "offset": 0.002}
